g.title: csync
g.text: csync phone app: pages, states and transitions (2.46)
Double-headed line = parent and child; the label is the tap that opens the child, Back returns along it.
From anywhere: the BOTTOM BAR opens Home, Media, Share, Chat or More; the QUICK RAIL (top corners) opens whichever pages and actions the owner picked in Settings.

g.title: cluster_pistates
g.text: Pi screen states, from /v1/player/pi (Home's status line, Media's foot row, the widget and the tile follow the same)

g.title: Home
g.text: states: Pi online · Pi offline · not connected
Pick up · Play Ask Send Camera · Your devices · status line

g.text: scopes: All · Media · Chats · Files · Devices
states: nothing typed · searching · N results

g.title: Media
g.text: Files: drives · folder (Up row, Load more) · empty · unreadable
foot: Pi screen row when idle, mini player when playing
folder rows open in place; Back never walks folders

g.title: PiScreen
g.text: shows whatever state the Pi reports (below)
idle: From the Pi · From this phone · This screen
playing: seek · pause · skip · stop · Volume Speed Rotate Loop
showing: Stop showing; document: Previous · Page N of M · Next
